$comment: Three invented research requests for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. The exchange, the companies and their filings do not exist. RSC-6001 Kestrelmoor Foods: clean results. RSC-6002 Tarnholt Marine Holdings: the half-year filing restates the annual figures. RSC-6003 Brindlewick Retail Group: the consensus on file is older than the half-year filing. Each case names only what the bank's research system holds.
